crossRefs.note: He took butter, milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them. He stood by them under the tree, and…
He asked for water. She gave him milk. She brought him butter in a lordly dish.
honey, butter, sheep, and cheese of the herd, for David, and for the people who were with him, to eat; for they said…
He will not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter.
He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good.
It shall happen, that because of the abundance of milk which they shall give he shall eat butter; for everyone will eat…
Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.
You shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of…
Listen to this word, you cows of Bashan, who are on the mountain of Samaria, who oppress the poor, who crush the needy…
Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your heritage, who dwell by themselves in a forest, in the middle of…
But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”
He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat.
Binding his foal to the vine, his donkey’s colt to the choice vine; he has washed his garments in wine, his robes in…
for this is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the remission of sins.
But I tell you that I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on, until that day when I drink it anew with…
For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.

people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

translations.web: butter from the herd, and milk from the flock, with fat of lambs, rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the finest of the wheat. From the blood of the grape, you drank wine.
translations.bsb: with curds from the herd and milk from the flock, with the fat of lambs, with rams from Bashan, and goats, with the choicest grains of wheat. From the juice of the finest grapes you drank the wine.
translations.kjv: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape.
translations.asv: Butter of the herd, and milk of the flock, With fat of lambs, And rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, With the finest of the wheat; And of the blood of the grape thou drankest wine.
